title: AN ORDINARY COUPLE, AN EXTRAORDINARY PLAN

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Now a man of the tribe of Levi married a Levite woman, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son." - Exodus 2:1-2a (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
No names are given here. Just a man from Levi and a woman from Levi, an ordinary marriage in a season of national terror. They are not royalty. They are not prophets. They are slaves.

And yet God has chosen this quiet household to raise the man who will confront Pharaoh.

We often imagine that God's important work begins in important places. But Scripture keeps showing us the opposite. The deliverer of Israel was born in a slave's home under a death sentence. Centuries later, the Saviour of the world was born in a borrowed stable to a carpenter's family in a small town.

If you are a parent in a small house, in an ordinary job, wondering whether your family matters in God's big picture — read this verse again. God's plans very often begin behind unremarkable doors.

Your faithfulness in an ordinary week is not wasted. God has never needed impressive people. He has only ever needed available ones.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I secretly believe God only uses people with position or platform?
2. What ordinary responsibility has God given me that I have been treating as insignificant?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You work through ordinary homes and ordinary people. Use my small, faithful obedience for Your purposes. Amen.
